tour.welcomeD: A one-minute look around. Skip it whenever you like: you can take it again from Me.
tour.trackD: Darsi shows one of your tracks at a time. Tap here to switch to another, or to add and remove tracks.
tour.weekD: Lessons done this week, against your weekly goal. Meet it week after week to grow your streak.
tour.lessonD: Start or continue here. Each course starts at your level, and each lesson is short: a video, a reading, questions and a hands-on lab. Darsi remembers where you stopped.
tour.learnD: Your courses, from your level up. Come back here to pick up where you left off.
tour.downloadsD: Save a course on this device and learn without internet. Your progress goes up when you're back online.
tour.labsD: Hands-on apps for AI, IoT, cyber security and more. They run on your device, so they work offline once opened.
tour.kitD: Slides and lesson plans for every lesson, in PDF and PowerPoint, to teach it in your own class.
tour.meD: Your language, data saver, notifications, levels and certificates. You can take this tour again from here.
tour.meStaffD: Your account and your staff pages, plus language, data saver, notifications and certificates. You can take this tour again from here.
tour.teachD: Your students: their progress, the projects waiting for your review, and their results.
tour.orgD: Your school or organization. Join one with an invite code, or ask to register yours.
tour.adminD: Your organization: people and classes, invite codes, your name and logo, and reports.
tour.superD: The whole platform: organizations, people, tracks, languages, plans and analytics.
tour.reportD: Something not working? Tap here. Darsi takes a picture of the screen and adds the details we need to fix it.
tour.doneD: That's the tour. You can take it again any time from Me.
